eyeclean-r57.description: eyeclean-r56b with a transformer detector: GuardTX (57.5M, initialised from EyeRestoreTX) in place of the EyeGuard CNN (detects and removes more catchlight with less collateral; about 1.4-1.8x the time per eye); same presence classifier, EyeRestoreTX (57.5M) and gate; needs EyeClean 0.4.0 or later; see MODEL_CARD.md
eyeclean-r57.input_note: any input colour EyeClean supports; tested on 1080p Rec.709 video, linear Rec.709 EXR and phone JPEG photos

eyeclean-r56b.description: eyeclean-r56 with EyeGuard's reflection channel also trained on iris-bank images (better removal of large, soft glare on close-ups and photos); same presence classifier, EyeRestoreTX (57.5M) and gate; see MODEL_CARD.md
eyeclean-r56b.input_note: any input colour EyeClean supports; tested on 1080p Rec.709 video, linear Rec.709 EXR and phone JPEG photos

eyeclean-r56.description: eyeclean-r54 with EyeGuard fine-tuned for recall on the catchlight (distilled to its round-54 self elsewhere) and the reflection hole exempt from the lid margin; same presence classifier and EyeRestoreTX (57.5M); see MODEL_CARD.md
eyeclean-r56.input_note: any input colour EyeClean supports; tested on 1080p Rec.709 video, linear Rec.709 EXR and phone JPEG photos

eyeclean-r54.description: eyeclean-r48 with EyeGuard and the reflection-presence classifier fine-tuned across iris sizes 8-160 px (better on close-up photos, fewer false edits); same EyeRestoreTX (57.5M); see MODEL_CARD.md
eyeclean-r54.input_note: any input colour EyeClean supports; tested on 1080p Rec.709 video, linear Rec.709 EXR and phone JPEG photos

eyeclean-r48.description: EyeGuard + reflection-presence classifier + EyeRestoreTX (57.5M), invariance fine-tuned, with a 0.5 px softened restorer input; see MODEL_CARD.md
eyeclean-r48.input_note: any input colour EyeClean supports; tested on 1080p Rec.709 video and linear Rec.709 EXR

best_single_r48.description: the development bundle eyeclean-r48 was made from: the same tensors plus an unused five-frame CNN slot and a development manifest; identical output
